title.narrative: Catalysing Investments and Power sector reform to Support the Energy Transition in Eswatini

description.narrative: The Action is financed under the 11th European Development Fund (EDF).The Actions overall objective is to carry out catalytic and targeted activities to contribute to establishing the necessary conditions for achieving the SDG7 (sustainable energy) and SGD 13 (climate action) within the context of the needs of Eswatini being heavily dependent on electricity imports while striving to provide clean energy access and stir economic growth.
